title: A Lesion-Necessity Test for Public Imaging Benchmarks: Brain Tumor MRI Classification Without the Tumor (code and outputs)
description: Code and saved per-fold outputs for the lesion-necessity test: classifiers are retrained with the annotated lesion deleted or isolated under identical subject-grouped folds and seeds, and each contrast is judged with a patient-clustered bootstrap interval. Applied to the Cheng et al. brain tumor MRI collection with a HAM10000 positive control. Source images are not redistributed.
